userPosition: Heavy cryptocurrency regulation protects consumers and prevents fraud
counterPosition: Strict crypto regulation stifles innovation and pushes development to other countries
content: The argument rests on reasoning: innovation often needs experimentation that does not fit existing regulatory categories, and the early internet grew under light-touch rules. Over-broad rules can also catch legitimate uses, as sanctions on privacy tools may. No verified source is cited for this argument.
limitations: The earlier developer-growth, job and fraud figures and their citations could not be traced to published sources and were removed.
Developer exodus may be temporary or reversible
Other factors beyond regulation affect crypto adoption
Comparing fraud across different financial systems is complex
Internet analogy may not apply to financial services
